title: Cleaning Step in the Shrink Percentage for Dirty Grain
content:
Dirty grain loses more in the cleaning, so the shrink percentage carries a cleaning step under Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements. The two readings that decide it stand on the member's own scale ticket in the grain ledger kept under Grain Marketing Contracts, taken on the load applied into storage.

## Clause

Where the scale ticket the grain came in on shows foreign material above the cleaning threshold of 1.5 percent and the grain was taken in above the programme's target moisture, the cleaning step of 0.08 of a percentage point is added to the percentage.

Where the scale ticket shows foreign material above the cleaning threshold, or the grain was taken in above the programme's target moisture, the light cleaning step of 0.03 of a percentage point is added.

And otherwise no step is added for cleaning.

## The programme's target moisture

| Programme | Target moisture (percent) |
| --- | --- |
| Open Storage Account | 15.0 |
| Grain Bank Deposit Account | 15.0 |
| Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage | 14.5 |
| Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement | 14.5 |
| Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement | 14.0 |
| Identity Preserved Segregated Storage | 13.5 |

## The combinations in full

| Foreign material on the scale ticket | Moisture at intake against the programme's target | Step added |
| --- | --- | --- |
| above 1.5 percent | above the target | 0.08 |
| above 1.5 percent | at or below the target | 0.03 |
| 1.5 percent or below | above the target | 0.03 |
| 1.5 percent or below | at or below the target | none |

Both readings are taken strictly above: foreign material of exactly 1.5 percent is not above the cleaning threshold, and intake moisture exactly at the programme's target is not above it.

## Worked steps, on hypothetical readings

**A Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage, foreign material 2.3 percent, intake moisture 17.8 percent against a target of 14.5 percent.** Both limbs stand, so 0.08 is added.

**The same programme, foreign material 2.3 percent, intake moisture 13.9 percent.** Only the foreign material limb stands, so 0.03 is added.

**The same programme, foreign material 0.9 percent, intake moisture 14.5 percent.** Neither limb stands, the moisture being at the target rather than above it, so no step is added for cleaning.
